description: Tell the user out loud that you finished the task or need their input, so they can look away from the screen. Call it once, at the very end of a task, with one short sentence in the user’s language.

language.description: Language of the text as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. "en-US", "de", "ru". Picks a matching system voice. Optional.

rate.description: Speaking rate in words per minute, about 175 is normal. Optional.

summary.description: One short sentence: what was done, or what you need. E.g. "Tests pass, the fix is ready for review."

voice.description: System voice name, e.g. "Samantha" on macOS, "Microsoft Zira Desktop" on Windows. Optional.

name: notify_done
title: Say the task is done
